title: FBI-UAP-PR004, “Northeastern Orb Sighting,” 2025
what_is_it: A public case record describing an eyewitness video (an iPhone recording) of an unidentified aerial object, released by the FBI as part of the war.gov PURSUE collection.
interpretation_warnings: No document body text was extracted (likely a video file with no accompanying readable PDF), so every fact here derives from war.gov catalogue metadata and the CSV blurb, not from an independently readable source document.
Single-source, unverified eyewitness account from two private individuals; no corroborating sensor data, radar, or third-party confirmation is present.
Object measurements (size, distance, height) are eyewitness estimates, not instrument readings.
Anonymous witnesses — no names, credentials, or independent identification are provided.
